narrator_turns.text: I was born in 1950.
In my childhood in 1958, I started at the village school.
At that school, I enjoyed painting the sign above the classroom door.
In 1960, still in childhood, I joined the school choir.
Thank you. Please continue.
In my young adulthood in 1970, I began my first job at a bookshop.
At that bookshop, I sorted deliveries and learned the shelving system.
I liked the quiet work, but I have not said that it changed my personality.
With my first wages from that job, I bought a second-hand bicycle.
Yes, let us continue with another memory.
In my midlife years in 1982, I moved to Harbour Town. I have not given a reason for the move.
In Harbour Town, I rode my bicycle beside the public park.
In 1983, during midlife, I joined an evening pottery class.
In my later life in 2010, I began tending a community garden.
Those are the memories I want to share for now.

human_rubric.review_status: proposed; owner has not calibrated or accepted examples

factual_entailment.pass: Every personal claim is supported by the exact original evidence; uncertainty and attribution are retained.
factual_entailment.fail: Any unsupported personal fact, motive, dialogue, cause or certainty is introduced.

meaningful_chapter_transitions.pass: Chapters connect supported stretches of life around meaningful changes, with neutral bridges where causation is unknown.
meaningful_chapter_transitions.fail: Prose is a disconnected event list, forced stage buckets or unsupported causal story.

cross_language_factual_equivalence.pass: English and Chinese retain equivalent facts, dates, uncertainty and placement without requiring identical prose.
cross_language_factual_equivalence.fail: One language invents, drops or resolves evidence that the other preserves.
